verdict.rationale: Buzz ships an official first-party CLI (crates/buzz-cli). It has documented commands for channels, repos, workflows and GIFs. It is built into agent workflows: the ACP harness has agents reply via the Buzz CLI, and a vendor-shipped 'buzz-cli' skill teaches agents to drive it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in real use, and evidence of installation/distribution docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: buzz repos protect set --id my-repo --ref refs/heads/main --push admin --no-force-push --no-delete
The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
relay operations: owner-reviewed agent drafts, messaging, channels, DMs, users, workflows, feed, reactions, canvas, social, repos, uploads, and agent memory.
